text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaah--------!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*...! *Gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... *wheeze*!
Hey... how was, that...?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: My running... was number one...?!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet! Scarlet!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was a fantastic match!
Your running is still burned into my mind!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: An unforgettable—no, a race I never *want* to forget! It was the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. That's... it!
I see...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, how's that...!
I won...! I totally won...!!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I went and became "Number One"...!
"And as if the tension finally snapped, Daiwa Scarlet let all the strength drain from her body."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Gulp, gulp... pwhaaah.
Phew, I feel alive again~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa there.
You look completely worn out."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wha, Vodka!?
You're...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't get all stiff on me, y'know?
I just came to check in and see how you're holdin' up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"You were strong. You've really gotten better.
Today's run was without a doubt the best of any Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...So... uh, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That "Number One" you keep talking about...
I think I'm starting to understand what it means.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, did you finally figure it out?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah!? Why are you acting so high and mighty—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, I didn't realize it myself
until after the race was over, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Winning the race, being showered with cheers,
and looking at the faces of each and every spectator."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I finally became number one in everyone's hearts.
That's what I thought—and then I realized.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The "number one" I'm aiming for
is an Umamusume who lives on in everyone's memories.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So that whenever anyone hears "Tenno Sho (Autumn),"
they'll remember this race where I battled tooth and nail.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She said she wanted to be the kind of presence where,
whenever people hear "Umamusume,"
the name "Daiwa Scarlet" comes up first.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...That doesn't sound bad.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though! The next one to win is gonna be me!
The next time we race, there's NO WAY I'm losing!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah. Hurry up and head overseas already.
You're still in the middle of your training journey, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"You're going overseas to train so you can beat me next time, right?
Fufu♪"

And so, while soothing the two who had started bickering,
we headed on our way back.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now then... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What do I need to do from now on
in order to become number one?
choice_data_list: I'll become everyone's number one at the "Arima Kinen"!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Spot on! Heheh,
you're pretty good yourself!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well then, just as we originally planned,
I'm going to become the “number one Umamusume”!

"I will win the Arima Kinen, no matter what"—she
made a firm vow with Daiwa Scarlet.
